simultaneous_information.consequence: Impossible to read the small left-side toast ('It shot a dart. It shot an EMPTY dart.') without looking away from incoming projectiles and missing the bottom subtitle.

clips.rating_evidence: Incoming targets and projectiles have high contrast against the dark background, making threat detection immediate. However, small low-contrast peripheral toasts on the far left and top-left compete with central dodging and bottom subtitles, lowering text legibility during combat.
clips.uncertainties: Picture-only ablation provides no audio. Exact trigger for the game pause at 0:25 and the meaning of 'Lock: Slicing' at 0:14 cannot be verified from visuals alone.
clips.minimal_fix: Consolidate left-side radio toasts and top-center codex popups near the bottom subtitle area or pause/slow combat when critical lore text appears.

ordered_observations.action_response: Ship moves right at 3s (prompting subtitle correction at 4s), moves left at 6s, then right at 11s, and vertically at 17s.
ordered_observations.goal_resource_change: Score remains 0; top-right counter remains 0 x1.0.
ordered_observations.uncertainty: Unclear why the scanning cone pulses continuously without targets.

ordered_observations.account: The ship remains near the right lane boundary while subtitles instruct on hitbox size, focus movement, and firing.
ordered_observations.action_response: Ship stays mostly stationary or moves very slightly near the right boundary; despite instructions to fire at 48s, no projectiles are emitted.
ordered_observations.uncertainty: Without an input log, it is impossible to tell if the player is holding a focus button between 34s and 43s or why no bullets fire after 48s.

simultaneous_information.competition: Subtitle references 'the small glowing gem at its center', requiring comparison between the bottom text and the bright bloom on the ship.
simultaneous_information.consequence: Because the entire ship glows brightly with bloom, distinguishing the specific 'small glowing gem' hitbox from the rest of the ship body is visually ambiguous.

clips.rating_evidence: With no threats on screen, the large bottom subtitles are easy to read and movement mistakes (going right instead of left at 0:03) are immediately recoverable. Cause attribution is rated 3 because the visual state for 'focusing' (0:34-0:43) and the central 'gem' hitbox are obscured by uniform bright bloom on the ship.
clips.uncertainties: No audio present. Cannot visually confirm what changes on the ship when 'focus' is held (0:37-0:43) or why firing does not occur at 0:48.
clips.minimal_fix: Give the center hitbox gem a distinct color/outline when 'focus' is held so the player can visually verify both the hitbox size and the focus state.

cross_clip_summary: Across both clips, primary bottom subtitles and combat threats (Sequence C) are highly legible, but secondary UI elements (tiny top-left 'Scanning' bars, far-left radio toasts, and top-right counters) are too small and dispersed to read during active dodging. Additionally, heavy glow/bloom on the player ship obscures the central hitbox gem and focus-mode state taught in Sequence G.
